This looks complete and correct. Since I can't run the dev server to visually verify, I'll note that explicitly.

I've built the edit profile screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`, using only Strata components (`Card`, `TextField`, `DatePicker`, `Select`, `Avatar`, `Button`, `Badge`, `ToastRegion`) and tokens. Summary of behavior:

- **Photo**: change via drag-drop or the "Change photo" button (PNG/JPEG, ≤5MB), shown as an `Avatar`.
- **Fields**: full name, email, phone, date of birth, preferred language — all controlled and compared against the last-saved snapshot.
- **Change tracking**: each changed field's label gets a "Changed" badge (text, not colour-only), and the card description summarizes how many fields changed since the last save.
- **Cancel**/**Save**: both disabled when nothing has changed; Cancel reverts to the last save, Save commits the snapshot and shows a success toast ("Profile saved").
- Copy is English-only; layout uses logical properties/tokens so it will mirror correctly in the app's Arabic/RTL mode via `ThemeScope`.

Both files scored 100 on `audit_snippet` with no findings. I could not run the dev server per the task constraints, so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser — worth a manual check, especially the RTL rendering and the date picker's locale formatting.
